## Objective and scope

Execute the frozen final candidate and reference on every reserved pair with no outcome-driven retuning or exclusion.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Keep every declared attempt, failure, timeout, affine-only fallback and rejected map in the results; report conditional and end-to-end reliability separately with uncertainty.
2. Compute bidirectional per-structure Dice, HD95, landmarks where available, cohort/tail statistics and subject-aware paired intervals with the frozen analysis.
3. Audit exported maps independently for complete-region coverage, cell Jacobians and composed-map inverse accuracy, plus saved-map/image reload checks. Report actual ANTs geometry too.
4. Save runtime/peak memory, diagnostics, images/maps, source/input/config seals and commands. Produce a pass/fail report against every frozen criterion; a failed run can complete this execution task but cannot pass G5.

## Planned areas

- benchmarks/flashalign/
- docs/benchmarks/evidence/

## Blocking prerequisites

- Q02 (`bd-01M4X4DZM817WNYDR9Z2EVKXEG`)

## Evidence and safeguards

Use Mote claims/path reservations when implementation begins. Preserve unrelated dirty work and immutable historical studies. Reuse canonical providers and current owners. Keep labels/evaluation-only masks out of fitting, tuning on qualification data, and runtime stopping. Record exact source/provider/input/config identities, commands, numerical tolerances and all failures; run affected JVM/Scala.js and independent numerical checks. Current geometry/export thresholds cannot be relaxed to improve a pass rate. Completed research may be negative; milestone/epic acceptance remains a separate evidence-based decision.
